question: The amount on a sum of ₹7,500 at 8% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Amount = P(1 + r/100)²

= 7500 × (1.08)²

= 7500 × 1.1664 = 8748

**∴ Answer = ₹8748**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 7500, Rate = 8% p.a., Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount = P(1 + r/100)^t

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount = 7500 × (1 + 8/100)²

⇒ = 7500 × (1.08)²

⇒ = 7500 × 1.1664

⇒ = 8748

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8748.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest

Interest is added to principal each year

Formula

A = P(1 + r/100)^t

Shortcut

Use (1 + r/100)² for 2 years directly

Key Insight

Multiply principal by growth factor

97
